<style>
  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero { position: relative; min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: radial-gradient(120% 100% at 70% 20%, var(--field-bg) 0%, var(--surface) 45%, var(--surface) 100%); overflow: hidden; }
  #iris { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 1; }
  .hero-vignette { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; background: radial-gradient(80% 80% at 28% 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 0%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent) 70%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 85%, transparent) 100%); pointer-events: none; }
  .hero > .wrap { position: relative; z-index: 3; width: 100%; flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding-top: calc(var(--nav-h) + 28px); padding-bottom: 48px; }
  .hero-inner { max-width: 760px; }
  .hero h1 { color: var(--ink); margin: 26px 0 28px; }
  .hero h1 .italic-accent { font-weight: 500; }
  .hero-lead { color: var(--ink-muted); max-width: 50ch; }
  .hero-actions { display: flex; gap: 18px; margin-top: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .scroll-hint { position: absolute; bottom: 130px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; pointer-events: none; }
  .scroll-hint .bar { width: 1px; height: 46px; background: linear-gradient(var(--accent-fill), transparent); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .scroll-hint .bar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -50%; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 50%; background: var(--accent-fill-hover); animation: scrolldot 2.2s var(--ease) infinite; }
  @keyframes scrolldot { 0% { top: -50%; } 60%,100% { top: 100%; } }

  .hero-stats { position: relative; z-index: 3; flex-shrink: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 50%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
  .hero-stats .wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .hstat { padding: 26px 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); padding-left: 28px; }
  .hstat:first-child { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
  .hstat .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.6rem); color: var(--accent-ink); line-height: 1; }
  .hstat .l { font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted); margin-top: 8px; }

  /* ---------- SECTION HEADER ---------- */
  .sec-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px; margin-bottom: clamp(44px, 6vw, 76px); flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .sec-head .left { max-width: 60ch; }
  .sec-head h2 { margin-top: 20px; }

  /* ---------- SERVICES ---------- */
  .svc-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .svc { position: relative; padding: clamp(34px, 4vw, 56px); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); overflow: hidden; transition: background 0.6s var(--ease); }
  .svc::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; height: 2px; width: 0; background: var(--accent-fill); transition: width 0.6s var(--ease); }
  .svc:hover { background: var(--ink); }
  .svc:hover::before { width: 100%; }
  .svc-num { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--accent-ink); letter-spacing: 0.2em; }
  .svc:hover .svc-num { color: var(--accent-fill-hover); }
  .svc h3 { margin: 22px 0 16px; transition: color 0.5s var(--ease); }
  .svc:hover h3 { color: var(--surface); }
  .svc p { color: var(--ink-muted); max-width: 42ch; transition: color 0.5s var(--ease); }
  .svc:hover p { color: var(--surface); }
  .svc-arrow { margin-top: 26px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; font-size: 0.76rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-ink); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); transition: all 0.5s var(--ease); }
  .svc:hover .svc-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: none; color: var(--accent-fill-hover); }

  /* ---------- PROCESS ---------- */
  .proc-wrap { position: relative; }
  .proc-line { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 38px; height: 1px; background: var(--line); }
  .proc-line .fill { height: 100%; width: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-fill), var(--accent-fill-hover)); transition: width 1.6s var(--ease); }
  .proc-wrap.in .proc-line .fill { width: 100%; }
  .proc-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 30px; position: relative; }
  .proc-step .dot { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--field-bg); border: 1px solid var(--accent-fill); position: relative; margin-bottom: 36px; transition: background 0.5s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.5s var(--ease); }
  .proc-wrap.in .proc-step .dot { background: var(--accent-fill); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--gold-glow); }
  .proc-step .pn { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--accent-ink); letter-spacing: 0.2em; }
  .proc-step h3 { color: var(--ink); margin: 12px 0 14px; font-size: 1.5rem; }
  .proc-step p { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.96rem; max-width: 30ch; }

  /* ---------- WHY US ---------- */
  .why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: center; }
  .globe-stage { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; max-width: 520px; margin-inline: auto; width: 100%; }
  .globe-stage svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
  .meridian { fill: none; stroke: var(--line-gold); stroke-width: 0.6; }
  .latitude { fill: none; stroke: var(--line-gold); stroke-width: 0.6; }
  .globe-outer { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-fill); stroke-width: 0.8; }
  .arc { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-fill-hover); stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-dasharray: 240; stroke-dashoffset: 240; }
  .why-grid.in .arc { animation: drawArc 2.4s var(--ease) forwards; }
  .why-grid.in .arc.a2 { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
  .why-grid.in .arc.a3 { animation-delay: 1s; }
  @keyframes drawArc { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
  .node { fill: var(--accent-fill-hover); }
  .node-pulse { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-fill-hover); transform-origin: center; }
  .why-grid.in .node-pulse { animation: nodePulse 2.6s var(--ease) infinite; }
  @keyframes nodePulse { 0% { r: 4; opacity: 0.9; } 100% { r: 22; opacity: 0; } }
  .dest { fill: var(--accent-fill); }
  .why-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px; background: var(--line); border: 1px solid var(--line); margin-top: 40px; }
  .why-stat { background: var(--surface); padding: 26px 24px; }
  .why-stat .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 2.9rem); color: var(--ink); line-height: 1; }
  .why-stat .l { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--ink-muted); margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.4; }

  /* ---------- ABOUT TEASER ---------- */
  .about-teaser { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 90px); align-items: center; }
  .about-teaser .quote { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3vw, 2.6rem); line-height: 1.25; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 400; }
  .about-teaser .quote .hl { color: var(--accent-ink); font-style: italic; }
  .principle-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .principle { display: flex; gap: 22px; padding: 24px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .principle:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .principle .pk { font-family: var(--serif); color: var(--accent-ink); font-size: 1.1rem; flex: none; width: 34px; }
  .principle h3 { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: normal; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .principle p { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; }

  /* ---------- CTA ---------- */
  .cta { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .cta-inner { text-align: center; max-width: 780px; margin-inline: auto; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .cta h2 { color: var(--ink); margin: 24px 0 26px; }
  .cta .lead { color: var(--ink-muted); margin-inline: auto; }
  .cta-glow { position: absolute; width: 60vw; height: 60vw; max-width: 720px; max-height: 720px; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold-glow) 0%, transparent 60%); opacity: 0.5; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; }

  @media (max-width: 880px) {
    .svc-grid, .proc-grid, .why-grid, .about-teaser, .hero-stats .wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .proc-line { display: none; }
    .proc-grid { gap: 0; }
    .proc-step { padding: 22px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 20px; }
    .proc-step .dot { margin-bottom: 0; }
    .hstat { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .hstat:first-child { border-top: 0; }
    .why-stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
